bugClass: incorrect regex (single-digit quantifier where multi-digit was needed)
bugSummary: The parse regex allowed only a single integer digit after a leading minus sign ('\\-?\\d?'), so negative decimals with two or more integer digits (e.g. '-10.5h') failed to match and returned undefined instead of the correct millisecond value.
triggerInput: ms('-10.5h') must be -37800000 (buggy returns undefined); ms('-100.5s') -> -100500; ms('-10.5m') -> -630000. Positive decimals (e.g. '10.5h') and single-digit negatives ('-1.5h') work in both.
